verdict.rationale: Canny's MCP server lets users ask their LLM directly about customer feedback themes, ARR impact, and roadmap data, and Autopilot automatically surfaces/organizes untracked feedback—both are AI-generated insight/suggestion mechanisms tied to the product's data. Evidence is vendor-sourced with no independent hands-on validation of insight quality. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of insight accuracy, and clearer in-product (non-MCP) AI insight surfaces beyond MCP/Autopilot.
